identity.name: Navihawk A-T
identity.one_liner: The solar-powered pilot chronograph with radio-controlled timekeeping and a slide-rule bezel — the most feature-dense Citizen at the $650 price point.

narrative.story: The Navihawk A-T is the full-spec pilot watch from Citizen's Eco-Drive line: solar charging (any light), radio-controlled time sync (Multi-Band 6), a slide-rule bezel, a 1/100-second chronograph, a world timer (43 cities), and two alarms. The U600 caliber is the Eco-Drive movement that powers it all from ambient light — no battery replacement. The 45mm titanium case keeps the weight manageable. The Navihawk is the most-cited Citizen pilot watch and the watch a collector cites when they want maximum functions per dollar.
narrative.collector_notes: Eco-Drive is Citizen's solar-charging technology (launched 1995). Multi-Band 6 syncs with radio towers in the US, UK, Germany, China, and Japan (2 towers). The slide-rule bezel performs fuel and distance calculations.
